'''Travis''' was a navigator for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that got captured by Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] on [[Outpost 256]] along with several Republic heads of state. Travis and the others were rescued from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]], after which Travis became hungry for some payback.
